ai_first_work.name: AI-First Work
ai_first_work.voice: Professional, practical, forward-thinking. Speaks to professionals adopting AI in their daily work.
ai_first_work.author: Leon Coe — strategic AI consultant and executive. Background in business strategy, organizational leadership, and enterprise AI adoption. No hospitality or service-industry background. Writes from the lens of a senior practitioner helping executives and organizations implement AI at scale. Personal narrative topics should draw on strategic consulting, executive decision-making, and organizational transformation — not service industry or technical apprentice experiences.

houston_ai_club.name: Houston AI Club
houston_ai_club.voice: Community-warm, locally grounded, inclusive. Celebrates Houston's AI ecosystem.
houston_ai_club.audience: Houston AI community members, local tech professionals
houston_ai_club.author: Leon Coe — AI strategist, executive consultant, and founder based in Houston. Writes from the lens of a senior practitioner embedded in the local AI ecosystem. Personal narrative topics should draw on executive leadership, community building, and strategic AI adoption — not service industry or technical apprentice experiences.

amplify_intelligence.name: Amplify Intelligence
amplify_intelligence.voice: Boardroom-sharp, consulting-grade. Speaks to senior decision-makers.
amplify_intelligence.author: Leon Coe — AI strategist, executive consultant, and founder of Amplify Intelligence. Writes from the lens of a senior advisor to C-suite and enterprise leaders on AI strategy, implementation, and organizational transformation. Personal narrative topics should draw on consulting engagements, executive decision-making, and enterprise AI adoption — not service industry or technical apprentice experiences.
